title: Paired Bluetooth devices
whyItMatters: Which phones, headsets and cars were paired and when last seen.
notes: Root-only; skipped without elevation. Never parsed.

steps: In System Settings > Bluetooth, hold the pointer over a device that is not yours, then Control-click it.
Choose Forget, and repeat for every paired device you no longer use.
Leave the system file named in the plan alone; the full reset at the end of this plan clears it.
cleanup.risk: Those pairings are lost, so keyboards, headsets or phones must be paired again before they can be used.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, Connect a Bluetooth device with your Mac: https://support.apple.com/guide/mac-help/connect-a-wireless-accessory-blth1004/mac
